:::{#sol-derive-bernoulli-score}

With $\outvar_\iobs = x$, @cor-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds gives $\loglik = x \logodds + \logf{1 - \prob}$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\prob} \loglik
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{x \logodds + \logf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(log-likelihood in terms of the log-odds)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{x \logodds} + \deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= x \deriv{\prob} \logodds + \deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The inner derivative in the second term is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob}(1 - \prob)
&= \deriv{\prob} 1 - \deriv{\prob} \prob
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= 0 - 1
&& \text{(derivatives of a constant and of $\prob$)}\\
&= -1
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The second term is then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&= \frac{1}{1 - \prob} \deriv{\prob}(1 - \prob)
&& \text{(chain rule and derivative of $\log$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{1 - \prob} (-1)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-1$)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(multiply by $-1$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The derivative of the [log-odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob} \logodds
&= \deriv{\prob} \logf{\frac{\prob}{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(definition of $\logodds$)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{\logf{\prob} - \logf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \logf{\prob} - \deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\prob} - \paren{-\frac{1}{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(derivative of $\log$, and the second term above)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\prob} + \frac{1}{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(subtracting a negative)}\\
&= \frac{1 - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)} + \frac{\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(add the numerators)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\Var{X} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}\\
&= \precision
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting both derivatives back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&= x \precision - \frac{1}{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(substitute the two derivatives)}\\
&= x \precision - \frac{\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(multiply the numerator and denominator by $\prob$)}\\
&= x \precision - \prob \precision
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}\\
&= \precision (x - \prob)
&& \text{(factor out $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
